title: Eilenberg-Moore category
description: JSON Schema for the Eilenberg-Moore category C^T of a monad T on C — the category whose objects are T-algebras (A, α) and whose morphisms are T-algebra morphisms (Eilenberg & Moore 1965; Mac Lane 1971 Ch. VI §2). The categorical home of 'all the structures with T-shape.' Specializes category by carrying a monad cell.

monad.description: The monad T whose category of T-algebras this is.
